task.description: Task slug from the branch, after tharun/ or saiteja/.

latest_commit.description: Commit the record describes. The bot commit that only refreshes this file is not this value.

pr.description: Open pull request URL, or an empty string when there is no pull request yet.

files_touched.description: Repo paths this open task owns. The action sets these from the diff and keeps critical-file claims.

tests.description: How to verify the task. Preserved once a person or agent sets it. Clear it to let the action refill it.
